Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP request — Novus evaluation

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the intro last week. As we talked about with the team, we want to establish a concise mutual action plan to drive our pilot evaluation across the clinical ops and procurement lanes. Can you share a MAP template that includes:

- Stakeholder roster and primary contacts (clinical, security, procurement)
- Success criteria for a 30-day pilot (latency, throughput, data handling)
- Acceptance gates and handoff to production
- A proposed close timeline and demo schedule

We have Samir (cc) owning the technical validation and Procurement listed above for contract intake. If you can put a first-pass doc together today/tomorrow we can co-edit and lock timelines.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffman
Director of Clinical Ops
Novus Health

Hi Lena — great to hear from you. Attaching a first-pass MAP architecture doc and a simple stakeholder lanes workbook. I seeded the doc with the items you called out and proposed a 30 -> 90 day acceptance flow so we can capture both quick validation and a scaled handoff.

Key sections I added:
- Objectives & success metrics (clinical accuracy, 95th percentile latency, integration throughput)
- Stakeholder lanes (owner, escalation path, weekly sync cadence)
- Acceptance gates (data residency checks, SOC 2 evidence, performance targets)
- Proposed timeline (week-by-week milestones and demo slots)

Action items for this week:
1) Samir: can you confirm the technical validation team and the expected test dataset size by Wednesday?
2) Procurement: please forward any standard MSA redlines or procurement timelines so we can align the demo -> contract path.
3) Marissa: I'll lean on you for customer success-facing acceptance criteria and the handoff checklist.

Google Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J
Attachments: MAP-architecture-stencil.gdoc (link stub), stakeholder-lanes.xlsx (attached)

I'll set a 30-minute co-edit on Wednesday afternoon to walk through the lanes. Proposed times: Wed 2pm or Thu 10am PT — let me know which works.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

- Explicit rollback criteria and a smoke-test checklist (so Novus can validate non-regression on day 0)
- Data access matrix (who touches PII / PHI during the pilot) — Samir, any input here?
- Demo runbook: 20-minute live demo + 10-minute Q&A, target audience: Clinical ops + Security + Procurement
